text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mm, that was quite an eventful
summer training camp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Plan A is all set...
Now all that's left is to prepare for the Kikuka Sho. If I do say so myself, my time management skills are simply splendid.

It's wonderful to see her so full of motivation, a complete turnaround from before the training camp.
However...
choice_data_list: (In the end, what even was Plan A...?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Guinea Pig!
Let's tackle these Classic races with all our might, shall we?

With the mystery left unsolved, summer drew to a close—
and the daily grind of training for the Kikuka Sho began.
